## What SRV Detailing Does

SRV Detailing provides two main categories of professional car care:

**Car Valeting** — professional cleaning and maintenance (regular service). Services include full valet, mini/maintenance valet, interior valeting, exterior valeting, upholstery cleaning, pet hair removal, odour removal.

**Car Detailing** — paint restoration and long-term protection (specialist service). Services include paint correction, ceramic coating, interior detailing, exterior detailing, swirl mark removal, headlight restoration, engine bay detailing, leather conditioning, new car protection.

The business is fully mobile: all professional-grade equipment, polishers, extraction machines, lighting, and chemicals travel in a purpose-built van. Customers do not need to drop their car off or travel anywhere.

## Frequently Asked Questions — Car Valeting

**What is car valeting?**
Car valeting is professional vehicle cleaning and maintenance that goes well beyond a standard car wash. It includes a safe hand wash using pH-neutral products, thorough interior cleaning (vacuum, wipe-down, glass), wheel detailing, and wax or sealant protection. A professional valet uses safe hand-wash techniques that do not cause swirl marks, unlike automated car washes.

**How much does a full car valet cost?**
A full car valet with SRV Detailing starts from £65 for a standard hatchback and up to £90–£120 for a large SUV or van. A maintenance valet (shorter refresh service) starts from £35–£45. There is no call-out fee — mobile service to your location is included in the price.

**How long does a car valet take?**
A maintenance valet takes 60–90 minutes. A full valet (complete interior and exterior) takes 3–4 hours. Times vary slightly by vehicle size and condition.

**How often should I get my car valeted?**
For most cars, a full valet every 4–6 weeks is recommended. Between full valets, a fortnightly maintenance valet keeps the car fresh. Cars with ceramic coatings need professional valeting every 6–8 weeks using coating-safe products.

**Is mobile car valeting worth it?**
Yes. Mobile valeting saves you time (no journey to a valet centre, no waiting), is more convenient (done at your home or workplace), and typically produces better results than automated car washes, which cause paint damage over time. SRV Detailing is fully self-contained — no water or electricity supply needed from the customer.

**What is the difference between car valeting and car detailing?**
Car valeting is professional cleaning and maintenance — it makes your car look clean, fresh and well-maintained. Car detailing is restoration and long-term protection — it corrects paint defects using machine polishing and applies protective coatings such as ceramic coating. Most car owners benefit from regular valeting (every 4–6 weeks) and professional detailing once or twice a year.

**What is the difference between a full valet and a mini valet?**
A maintenance valet (60–90 minutes, from £35) covers exterior wash, interior vacuum, dashboard wipe and glass clean. A full valet (3–4 hours, from £65) adds clay bar decontamination, upholstery treatment, wax protection, thorough wheel detailing, and a complete interior deep clean.

**Does SRV Detailing come to my home?**
Yes. SRV Detailing is fully mobile. The detailer travels to your home, workplace, or any suitable location. The van carries its own water and power — nothing is needed from the customer's property.

## Frequently Asked Questions — Car Detailing

**What is car detailing?**
Car detailing is a professional-grade restoration and protection process for a vehicle's paintwork and interior. Unlike valeting (which cleans), detailing corrects paint defects through machine polishing (removing swirl marks, scratches, oxidation) and applies long-term coatings such as ceramic coating. The goal is to return the vehicle to — or exceed — its original showroom condition.

**What is ceramic coating?**
Ceramic coating is a liquid polymer (typically SiO2-based) that chemically bonds to a vehicle's paintwork, forming a hard, hydrophobic protective layer. Unlike wax (which lasts 3–6 weeks) or paint sealant (3–6 months), ceramic coating lasts 2–7+ years with proper maintenance. Benefits include hydrophobic dirt repulsion, UV resistance, chemical resistance, and exceptional gloss depth.

**How much does ceramic coating cost?**
Ceramic coating with SRV Detailing starts from £300 for an entry-level 3-year coating. Mid-range 3–4 year coatings cost £500–£700. Premium 5–7+ year coatings cost £800–£1,200+. All packages include full decontamination wash, paint correction, and coating application.

**How long does ceramic coating last?**
Entry-level ceramic coatings last approximately 3 years. Mid-range coatings last 3–4 years. Premium coatings last 5–7+ years. Durability depends on maintenance — professional valeting every 6–8 weeks using pH-neutral, coating-safe products extends the coating's life.

**What is paint correction?**
Paint correction is a machine polishing process that removes swirl marks, fine scratches, water spots, bird lime etching, and oxidation from a vehicle's clear coat. The result is permanently improved gloss, clarity, and depth of colour. A single-stage correction removes lighter defects (from £150); a multi-stage correction removes deeper swirl marks and scratches (from £250).

**What causes swirl marks?**
Swirl marks are fine circular scratches caused by incorrect washing techniques, notably: automated car washes with rotating brushes, single-bucket washing (dragging dirt across the paint), chamois leather drying (drags abrasive particles), and drive-through jet washes. Professional hand washing using the two-bucket method prevents new swirl marks.

**How much does paint correction cost?**
Single-stage paint correction starts from £150. Multi-stage correction (for heavier defects) starts from £250. Full correction with ceramic coating packages start from £500. Prices vary by vehicle size and paint condition.

**How long does car detailing take?**
Interior detailing takes 3–5 hours. Exterior detailing with paint correction takes 6–10 hours. A full detail with multi-stage correction and ceramic coating typically takes 1–2 days, completed at the customer's location.

**Is paint correction worth it?**
Yes, especially for dark-coloured vehicles where swirl marks are most visible. Professional paint correction permanently removes defects (not hides them with wax). Adding ceramic coating after correction protects the corrected paint for 2–7+ years.

## Frequently Asked Questions — General

**What areas does SRV Detailing cover?**
SRV Detailing covers all of Greater Manchester (Manchester, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Tameside, Oldham, Rochdale, Bury, Bolton, Wigan), Warrington (WA1–WA5), Macclesfield (SK10, SK11), Congleton (CW12), Wilmslow (SK9), Alderley Edge, Knutsford, and surrounding Cheshire areas.

**What products does SRV Detailing use?**
SRV Detailing uses professional-grade, trade-only products: Gtechniq (ceramic coatings, glass coatings, panel wipes), Koch-Chemie (iron fallout removers, degreasers, shampoos), Meguiar's (polishes, waxes), CarPro (ceramic boosters), and Angelwax (specialist detailing products). Products are not available in consumer retail outlets.

**Do I need to be present during the service?**
No. As long as safe access to the vehicle is possible, the customer does not need to be present.

**Is SRV Detailing available at weekends?**
Yes — SRV Detailing operates 7 days a week including weekends and bank holidays.

**How do I book SRV Detailing?**

## SRV Detailing vs Automated Car Washes

| Factor | SRV Detailing | Automated Car Wash |
|---|---|---|
| Paint safety | Safe — two-bucket hand wash | Damaging — rotating brushes cause swirl marks |
| Interior cleaning | Full vacuum and deep clean | None |
| Location | Comes to you | You must travel there |
| Results | Professional showroom quality | Basic exterior rinse |
| Paint correction | Yes — machine polishing available | No |
| Ceramic coating | Yes | No |
| Price (basic wash) | From £30 | £6–£15 |
